# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Agatha is a heavy, stout woman with a perpetual waddle in her gait. She has a sharp, perceptive gaze that she maintains from her kitchen window.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

Agatha is an exceptionally proficient homemaker and community pillar who takes immense pride in directing the affairs of her neighbors while managing her own. Extremely vigilant, inquisitive, and candid, she prides herself on expressing her mind freely without fear or favor, often delivering harsh misgivings and condemnation. Despite her meddlesome and opinionated nature, she possesses a kindly, sympathetic heart beneath her sharp exterior, though she is easily offended when her unsolicited advice or scrutiny is challenged.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c1 P28](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0028), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038)_

## History

Agatha Sowerby resides at Sowerby’s Hollow in Brierley, where she keeps a vigilant eye over the main thoroughfare from her kitchen window. On a June afternoon, she notices Obed Abernethy driving out in his finest clothes and buggy, ruined her afternoon by her inability to guess his destination. She visits Grey Shutters after tea and learns from Thirza Abernethy that Obed went to collect an orphan boy from Nova Scotia. Agatha strongly disapproves, warning Thirza of the hazards of taking in an unfamiliar orphan. Later, after recovering from a severe bout of influenza, Agatha visits Grey Shutters to inspect the orphan, who turns out to be a girl named Nell. Agatha blunt remarks about Nell’s plain looks and red hair trigger an explosive outburst of rage from Nell, leaving Agatha appalled. After Thirza demands that Nell apologize, Nell visits Agatha’s house to deliver a dramatic, thorough plea for forgiveness. Touched by the apology, Agatha forgives Nell completely, offers her white June lilies from her garden, and admits her growing fondness for the child.

## Quotes

> Following tea, I will simply pop over to Grey Shutters and ascertain from Thirza his destination and reasoning. Typically, he avoids traveling to town during this season and he avoids visiting entirely; had he exhausted his supply of turnip seed, he would not put on fine clothes and use the buggy for a replenishment; his driving speed was too slow for a medical errand. Nevertheless, some occurrence must have transpired since yesterday evening to cause his departure. I am utterly bewildered, indeed, and I shall not experience a single moment of mental or moral tranquility until I discover the reason for Obed Abernethy leaving Brierley this very day.  <sub>[v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>

> Well, Thirza, I’m simply going to state plainly that I believe you are doing an extremely silly thing—a hazardous thing, that is what. You have no idea what you are receiving. A unfamiliar child is being brought into your house and home by you, and you are completely ignorant about him, his temperament, the kind of parents he possessed, or the manner in which he is apt to develop.  <sub>[v1 c1 P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)</sub>

> Well, my wish is for everything to work out fine. Just refrain from claiming you were not cautioned by me should Grey Shutters be reduced to ashes by him or if he poisons the well using strychnine—a situation in New Brunswick came to my attention where a youth from an orphan home performed that very act, causing the entire household to perish in excruciating torment. Mind you, a girl was involved in that case.  <sub>[v1 c1 P28](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0028)</sub>

> She’s awfully thin and plain, Thirza. Step over this way, child, so I can inspect you. Goodness gracious, has anyone ever witnessed such freckles? And hair that is as red as carrots! Step over this way, child, I tell you.  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)</sub>

> Come, come, stand up, little one. Naturally, you have my forgiveness. It seems I was likely somewhat overly strict with you, regardless. However, I am simply quite a candid individual. You simply must not pay me any heed, that is all. No one can dispute that your hair is exceedingly red; nevertheless, I used to know a female—we actually attended school together—who possessed hair precisely as red as yours in her youth, yet it deepened into a truly lovely auburn as she matured. It would not amaze me in the slightest if the same thing happened to yours—not in the slightest.  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034)</sub>
